data.answer: The study marks **2013 and 2014** as the examination-request years in which the Raising the Bar reforms took effect.[1] More precisely, the new law applied to applications for which examination was requested **after 12 April 2013**.[2]

citations.quote: The dashed vertical lines mark exam request years of 2013 and 2014, the period in which the Raising the Bar reforms took effect.
